findings.claim: The apply retry ('rs with no try: what happens when the block ends?') assesses that Statement.close also closes its current ResultSet, which the page never teaches (it appears only in a source-link title). A learner who missed the first close-order question is retried on an untaught fact rather than the same goal shown another way.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence to the step-3 teaching ('closing a statement also closes its current ResultSet; still declare it in try-with-resources'), or make the retry another close-order item.
